quote: We introduce Altogether, an approach to improve image captions through the process of re-aligning existing alt-texts with the image content.

We evaluate our re-aligned captions across captioning, generative and discriminative tasks. ... Our Altogether captioner improves over alt-texts by 4% on CLIP score and significantly outperforms off-the-shelf captioners such as GiT, BLIP2 and LLaVA.
This paper presents a principled approach to enhance caption quality and develops a parameter-efficient captioner capable of scaling re-captioning efforts.
outputs: dense captions with concrete visual concepts, improved alignment between image and text
